releaseNotes:
## Navigation

- The top menu now moves items that do not fit into a hamburger menu, keeping their configured order. Items return to the top bar when more space is available.

## Guest Inbox

- Added an AI summary button at the right end of the email action row. Summaries appear inline only when requested, with streaming, collapse, copy, regenerate and hide controls.
- Thread summaries use local Ollama only, with cleaned chronological email text, bounded long-thread input, and clear offline or missing-model messages. Uses the existing Local AI URL and downloaded model settings; cloud models and remote endpoints are blocked.
- Added renaming for custom mailbox folders while preserving messages, subfolders, sync progress and sidebar preferences.
- Reply arrows now mark the specific incoming message that was answered, including replies synchronized from another mail app. Improved matching of multi-message reply headers and reference chains.
- Removed the duplicate linked-stay entry and clarified editing or switching to another stay for the same contact.

## Booking forms

- Remarks and allergies now stay directly below travel details as the guest list grows. Inbox and mobile forms retain their existing section order.

## Updates

- Improved patch publishing, recovery after interrupted releases, credential fallback, and public download verification. Update manifests cannot replace a newer published version with an older one.
